record.bible_text: David<WH01732> therefore departed<WH03212><WTH8799> thence, and escaped<WH04422><WTH8735> to the cave<WH04631> Adullam<WH05725>: and when his brethren<WH0251> and all his father's<WH01> house<WH01004> heard<WH08085><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> , they went down<WH03381><WTH8799> thither to him.

When Saul<WH07586> heard<WH08085><WTH8799> that David<WH01732> was discovered<WH03045><WTH8738>, and the men<WH0582> that <FI>were<Fi> with him, (now Saul<WH07586> abode<WH03427><WTH8802> in Gibeah<WH01390> under a tree<WH0815> in Ramah<WH07414>, having his spear<WH02595> in his hand<WH03027>, and all his servants<WH05650> <FI>were<Fi> standing<WH05324><WTH8737> about him;) <RF>tree...: or, grove in a high place<Rf>
